stemMd: What is the units digit of 7²⁰?
explanationMd: The units digits of successive powers of seven repeat as 7, 9, 3, 1. The cycle length is four and 20 is divisible by four, so the units digit is the fourth cycle value, 1. Only the last digit matters for this calculation.

distractorRationale.d: This is the first value in the repeating cycle.
distractorRationale.e: This occurs when the exponent has remainder two modulo four.
distractorRationale.c: This occurs when the exponent has remainder three modulo four.
distractorRationale.a: Powers of seven never end in zero.
